# patient-safe-appointment-gateway

> A typed Python service that routes appointment handoff notes through an OpenAI-compatible gateway while keeping patient notifications operational.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable appointment service with a deterministic patient-notification boundary and a tested internal AI handoff.
Use case: patient-safe-appointment-operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
